title: Pauline Oliveros — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Pauline Oliveros's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.by: Stable Audio Open and Sound from Code · 2026-11-15
pieces.title: One point, then the whole sphere
pieces.caption: Press play; the picture beneath says what you are hearing. *What is real and what is a choice:* A built room, not a recording. The drip, the bird, the far bell, the low piano string and the rain were each generated one at a time by Stable Audio Open and cut and placed by hand; the mains hum is synthesized, and here sits 12 dB lower than in the version first heard. In the first half everything but the drip is turned down fifty times (34 dB), the maker's stand-in for not attending; the page says sound 'arrives whether you attend to it or not', and here it nearly does not. The rain is set a little wider than the other sounds and swells slowly; the drips are nudged off an even beat. Which takes were kept was chosen by measurement, not by ear, and nobody has heard this version yet. *Leaking in:* John Cage, whom her page's links say she contradicts: the low string, plucked and buzzing inside the piano, is a nod to the prepared piano on his page, though nothing was laid between its strings.

verdicts.file: Pauline Oliveros — rich — one point, then the whole sphere.m4a
verdicts.why: Faithful to the page's focal and global, and the honest line owns the big choice. But "forty times" is fifty, in the honest line and in the picture's footer, and "a prepared string from his piece" reads as Cage's own piece when it is the maker's synthesized pluck from the sound on the Cage page.

verdicts.file: Pauline Oliveros — rich — one point, then the whole sphere, generated and placed.m4a
verdicts.by: challenger · a read-only dispatch that neither made nor placed it
verdicts.why: Every number holds when recomputed (fifty times is 33.98 dB; the hum falls 11.0 to 11.7 dB at 60, 120 and 180 Hz, about 0.4 dB short of 12 because the louder mix was normalized up more; the rain's left/right correlation 0.574 against the model's 0.578). Kept on condition that the caption own the rain's swell, the drips' jitter and that nobody has heard it, and stop calling the string prepared; done. It tests the page's focal-then-global claim rather than decorating it; beside the hand room it would only repeat it, so it is offered as a replacement, not an addition.
